يستأنس (form X)
# يَسْتَأْنِسُ (yastaʔnisu) /jas.taʔ.ni.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past active indicative of اِسْتَأْنَسَ (istaʔnasa)
# يُسْتَأْنَسُ (yustaʔnasu) /jus.taʔ.na.su/: third-person masculine singular non-past passive indicative of اِسْتَأْنَسَ (istaʔnasa)
# يَسْتَأْنِسَ (yastaʔnisa) /jas.taʔ.ni.sa/: third-person masculine singular non-past active subjunctive of اِسْتَأْنَس
